findings.description: The requirement places no lower bound on the first refresh after the window watchdog is enabled, so it permits an early refresh that causes a reset during fault-free start-up, contrary to SYS-SUP-015. OP-SWR-001 also identifies this missing first-refresh limit.
findings.requested_change: Require the first refresh after enabling to avoid an early watchdog reset, with any hardware-specific limit resolved from supported evidence.

findings.description: The requirement bounds refresh intervals during start-up but does not bound the interval between the last start-up refresh and the first refresh under SWR-WDG-004. That first normal refresh could occur too early or too late and cause a watchdog reset.
findings.requested_change: Specify the permissible refresh interval across the transition from start-up to normal servicing, consistent with SYS-SUP-012 and SYS-SUP-015.
